snippet.title: Memoreum - Official Release Date Trailer | Upload VR Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Step into the dangerous world of Memoreum in this trailer for the VR sci-fi action horror game. The Memoreum trailer shows gameplay and the terrifying monsters you'll fight. The Ichor Infection has taken over the last ship of humanity. You are Dr. Otto Hudson, fighting to unravel the mystery behind the outbreak as your fragmented mind slips from reality. Memoreum will be available on Meta Quest on October 9, 2025.
